subject: How do I change my display name?
issue: I want to update my display name on my HackerRank profile but can't find the option.
response: To change your display name on HackerRank, log in to your account, click your profile picture at the top right, then 'Profile', followed by 'Edit Profile'. Update the 'Name' field with your desired display name and click 'Save Changes'.

subject: How do I report my lost card?
issue: I cannot find my Visa card and I am worried it might have been stolen. What steps should I take?
response: To report a lost Visa card, call the 24/7 number on the back of your card, or your issuer's main customer service line. You can also report it through your card issuer's mobile app or online banking. This will block the card immediately and prevent unauthorized use. If you notice unauthorized transactions, report them promptly to be covered under Visa's Zero Liability Policy.
justification: Ticket asks about reporting a lost card; cited chunks describe the exact steps to report a lost card and the benefits of Visa's Zero Liability Policy.

subject: How do I cancel my Claude Pro subscription?
issue: I want to cancel my Claude Pro subscription. Can you tell me how to do that and whether I get a refund?
response: To cancel your Claude Pro subscription, go to Settings > Billing and click 'Cancel subscription'. Your Pro features will remain active until the end of the billing period. Unfortunately, no refunds are given for partial months.

subject: Can I use my Visa card in Europe?
issue: I am traveling to France next month and want to know if my Visa card will work there and if there are extra fees.
response: Visa cards are widely accepted in 200+ countries and territories. However, some cards may charge a foreign transaction fee of 1%–3% of the purchase amount when used abroad. To avoid this fee, choose to pay in the local currency instead of your home currency. Additionally, notify your bank before traveling to avoid having your card declined. If your card is declined, try a different ATM or terminal, call the international collect number on the back of your card, or have a backup payment method.
justification: Ticket asks about using a Visa card in Europe; cited chunks describe international transactions, foreign transaction fees, and card activation.

subject: My IDE is frozen during the test
issue: The in-browser IDE stopped responding 20 minutes into my coding test. I cannot type or submit. Help urgently.
response: If your IDE freezes during a test, don't close the tab. Wait 30 seconds for it to recover. If still frozen, hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R / Cmd+Shift+R). If you lose progress, contact the recruiting company to explain the situation. Your code is auto-saved every 30 seconds, so reopening the assessment link from your email should restore your progress if you saved before closing.
justification: Ticket asks about IDE freezing during a test; cited chunks describe troubleshooting steps and auto-save behavior.

subject: How do I change my PIN?
issue: I want to change my Visa card PIN. I know my current PIN but want to update it to something easier to remember.
response: To change your Visa card PIN, visit an ATM affiliated with your issuing bank, insert your card, and enter your current PIN. Then, select 'PIN Change' and enter your new 4-6 digit PIN. Confirm the new PIN. Alternatively, you can change your PIN through your issuer's mobile app, online banking, or by calling the number on the back of your card.
justification: Ticket asks about changing the PIN; cited chunks describe the exact self-serve flow on the ATM and alternative methods through the issuer's services.

subject: How many messages can I send per day on the free plan?
issue: I am on the free plan and want to know exactly how many messages I can send before I hit the daily limit.
response: On the free plan, you can send a limited number of messages per day. The exact number depends on message length, model used, and current platform demand.
